TRAEFIK_VERSION.description: Specify the version of Traefik to use.
TRAEFIK_VERSION.patternErrorMessage: Version must be in the format 'vX.Y.Z'

TRAEFIK_LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt notifications.
TRAEFIK_LETSENCRYPT_EMAIL.patternErrorMessage: Please enter a valid email address.

TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_INSECURE.description: Enable insecure mode for the Traefik dashboard (not recommended for production).

TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_PORT.description: Port number for accessing the Traefik dashboard.

TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_ADMIN_USER.patternErrorMessage: Username can only contain letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.

TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_DOMAIN.description: The domain name for the Traefik dashboard.

TRAEFIK_LOG_LEVEL.description: Set the log level for Traefik.
